FEAT4-ST-016.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema

FEAT4-ST-017.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Orchestration

FEAT4-ST-018.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade

FEAT4-ST-019.title: Add Unit Tests for Provider Detail Service
FEAT4-ST-019.description: Create unit tests covering NPI lookup success, partial data handling, error scenarios, and schema compliance for provider detail responses.

FEAT4-ST-020.title: Validate Tool Router Integration for Provider Detail
FEAT4-ST-020.description: Ensure provider detail lookup is properly registered in tool_router with input validation and safe dispatch, enabling LLM-driven invocation.
